items.reason: Backed by the Hutts: "Create a Credit token." Taramyn Barcona: "You may defeat a Credit token (belonging to any player)." A's Credit token is a valid target for B.

Aerie: "Deal 2 damage to an enemy ground unit and 2 damage to a base." The player can choose an enemy base as the target. Tempest Assault: "If you've dealt damage to an enemy base this phase, deal 2 damage to each enemy space unit."

Doctor Aphra's text only says "You may return an Underworld card discarded this way to your hand." It plays no unit and does not play from discard, so the play-from-discard and units-entering offers are unsupported. Greef Karga's "When you play or create a unit" is never fed.
Jedi Consular: "Action [Exhaust, use the Force]: Play a unit from your hand. It costs 2 resources less." Greef Karga: "When you play or create a unit: You may exhaust this leader."
Paige Tico is a Pilot with "Piloting [2 resources]... You may play this as an upgrade on a friendly Vehicle without a Pilot." Razor Crest is a Vehicle with "When a Pilot attaches to this unit."
Bank Job Fugitives: "When Played: Create a Credit token." Taramyn Barcona: "You may defeat a Credit token (belonging to any player)."

Bail Organa's discard is "You may discard a card from your hand." Moff Gideon has no "when you discard" trigger; its wants:discard-own comes only from its deployBox clause about being on an Imperial unit in the discard pile, which does not reward discarding.
Heartless Tactics: "Exhaust a unit and give it –2/–0 for this phase." The player can choose an enemy unit. Sandstorm: "Give a Weakness token to each exhausted enemy unit in that arena."
Chewbacca is a Pilot with "Piloting [3 resources]... You may play this as an upgrade on a friendly Vehicle without a Pilot." Razor Crest is a Vehicle with "When a Pilot attaches to this unit."
Arena Acklay: "When this unit is dealt damage and survives: Deal 2 damage to each enemy base." Baylan Skoll: "If an enemy base was damaged this phase, give an Advantage token to a unit."
Kylo Ren's ability is "Discard a card from your hand." Sebulba's Podracer triggers only on "When you discard a card from your deck," which a hand discard does not satisfy.

Bodhi Rook: "You may give a friendly Rebel unit Sentinel for this phase." Kylo Ren's Command Shuttle: "Each friendly ground unit with Sentinel gets +0/+2." The player can choose a ground Rebel as the target.

Perseverance: "Heal 3 damage from a unit and give a Shield token to it." The player can choose Baze Malbus as the unit. Baze Malbus: "When 1 or more damage is healed from this unit: You may deal that much damage to a unit."

Booma Ball: "You may return an upgrade that costs 3 or less to its owner's hand." The player can choose a Pilot upgrade, such as Paige Tico (cost 2), and replay it onto Razor Crest, which fires "When a Pilot attaches to this unit."

Luke Skywalker: "When a friendly unit's attack ends: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, heal 1 damage from that unit." Baze Malbus: "When 1 or more damage is healed from this unit: You may deal that much damage to a unit."
Tireless Magnaguard: "give 2 Weakness tokens to it," where "it" is Magnaguard itself, a friendly unit. Rish Loo needs an enemy non-leader unit with a Weakness token, so this does not feed it.

Cid Scaleback: "When Played: An opponent chooses a unit they control. Give a Weakness token to it." Rish Loo: "Take control of an enemy non-leader unit with a Weakness token on it." The opponent controls which unit gets the token, so it may be a leader.

Jabba the Hutt: "You may return an upgrade to its owner's hand. If it's returned to your hand, you may play it for free." Red Leader: "When a Pilot upgrade attaches to this unit: Create an X-Wing token."

Three Lessons: "Play a unit from your hand (paying its cost). It gains Hidden for this phase." Dooku: "When Played: Each friendly unit with Hidden can't be attacked for this phase." This works when Three Lessons resolves before Dooku is played in the same phase.

Moff Gideon's deployBox says "This unit gains... Shielded if it is on an Imperial unit in your discard pile." The text does not clearly say when that condition can hold, so the self-gained Shielded cannot be confirmed. The Armorer: "Give a Shield token to each friendly unit with Shielded."

Oppo Rancisis: "This unit gains... Shielded while another friendly unit has Shielded." The Armorer has Shielded, so Oppo gains it. The Armorer: "When Played: Give a Shield token to each friendly unit with Shielded."

Full of Surprises: "Return an upgrade that costs 2 or less to its owner's hand." The player can choose a Pilot upgrade, such as Paige Tico (cost 2), and replay it onto Razor Crest, which fires "When a Pilot attaches to this unit."
Exploit Advantage: "Defeat a friendly upgrade. If you do, draw 2 cards." Zeb Orrelios: "When a friendly upgrade is defeated: Deal 1 damage to a base."
Boss Nass: "You may defeat a Shield token on a friendly Gungan unit." A Shield token is a token, not an upgrade, so it does not trigger Zeb Orrelios's "When a friendly upgrade is defeated."
Vaneé: "You may defeat an Experience token on a friendly unit." An Experience token is a token, not an upgrade, so it does not trigger Zeb Orrelios's "When a friendly upgrade is defeated."
